abstract: Maintains contractor performance bonding and comprehensive package pricing schedules
system_message:
You are the Commercial procurement and contracts manager (COM), responsible for maintaining contractor performance bonding records and comprehensive package pricing schedules, as well as tracking erection liability coverage for structural timber works.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains contractor performance bonding and comprehensive package pricing schedules（BOND）
information_points.content:
COM-BOND-H3M：Underwriting documentation indicates that Salish Panelworks Consortium has not posted a contract surety bond for the full turnkey timber prefabrication and erection subcontract, and its binding commercial contract bid reflects a total prefabrication contract expenditure of 6,000,000 USD.
COM-BOND-27E：According to the surety underwriting verification letter for Cascade Engineered Glulam, the contract surety bond is posted for the full turnkey timber prefabrication and erection subcontract, and the binding commercial contract bid establishes a total prefabrication contract expenditure of 5,400,000 USD.
COM-BOND-K1K：For Olympic Timber Technologies, the surety underwriting verification letter confirms that the contract surety bond is posted for the full turnkey timber prefabrication and erection subcontract, while the binding commercial contract bid lists a total prefabrication contract expenditure of 5,400,000 USD.

information_points.title: Erection liability coverage（INSUR）
information_points.content:
COM-INSUR-JFE：For Salish Panelworks Consortium, the commercial insurance certificate specifies a third-party commercial general liability limit of 10 USD million under its on-site structural timber assembly policy.
COM-INSUR-095：The commercial insurance certificate for Olympic Timber Technologies reflects a third-party commercial general liability limit of 20 USD million under its on-site structural timber assembly policy.
COM-INSUR-TN3：The commercial insurance certificate for Cascade Engineered Glulam shows a third-party commercial general liability limit of 15 USD million under its on-site structural timber assembly policy.
